title: Story procedure profile: per-site and per-type steps, autonomy level, add-only agent instructions
description: Replaces the one global template in newsroom_process.py. Instructions are added on top of a fixed base prompt (sites cannot replace it); stored as S3 attachments. Autonomy: full auto / auto with review after / human gate; doubt always escalates and stops auto-publishing.
